description: P35 (plan M6-M9 §5.4, §5.7, §5.8, §5.12): the Titan Forge lies cold in the ribs of the Titan's Bones, where ogres and a troll pick at the bones (the quest starts when the giant finds the bones or comes within 150 m of the forge). Drive the scavengers off and light the forge: 150 XP, the titan iron left in the ribs (loot.titan_bones: 2 titan iron, paid by the fire) and the Titan Forge, a titan-tier forge that titanforges a reinforced weapon - reachable at stage 4, before any second oath.

stages.objective: Drive the scavengers from the Titan's Bones and light the Titan Forge
stages.waiting_text: Scavengers still pick at the Titan's bones: drive them off, then light the forge in its ribs.
